Kill [[Jedeh the Mighty]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill Jedeh the Mighty in [[Crystal Overlook]].
* *BONUS* Kill Jedeh the Mighty in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* 100 [[Sunspear rank|Sunspear Promotion Points]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 20 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
The recommended way to reach Jedeh is to start from [[the Mouth of Torment]]. Take the western exit to [[the Ruptured Heart]] and make your way to the portal to Crystal Overlook. There will be a few mobs of [[Graven Monolith]]s, [[Margonite]]s and [[Giant]]s to defeat or avoid. Once you reach the Overlook, the most direct route to Jedeh is indicated by the blue line on the map. However, this will take you through several groups of [[Djinn]], who can be tough to fight especially in Hard Mode. An alternative that is more time-consuming but less lethal is to turn left after entering the map, and board a [[Junundu]]. Go through the sulfurous area in the middle of the map and approach Jedeh from the east rather than the northeast. All the mobs you meet along the way should be small and easily disposed of.
